author: OrthodoxMusicOnline (OMIO), with David Drillock
description: David Drillock conducts a choir through three alleluia verses in a simple 4 pattern, filmed three-quarter front, waist to head with the knees in frame; the choir is legato and carries no usable beat (librosa's grid ran at 123 bpm against his 87), so the grid is his own baton hand
